before: A document under 512 KiB of content always mounts synchronously, at the zoom the editor holds, and fits after.
after: With openAfterPaint 'every', such a document mounts behind a painted frame with its fonts resolved, at its fit, and lays out the pass at its held zoom first, unpainted, so its pages are unchanged.
reason: Only when local layout runs changes. Nothing about opening or layout enters shared state, operations, snapshots or protocol messages.
